column1: # Scalar cases: an entry, its arguments and the answer it must give.
#   id      unique; names the case in output
#   want    the answer, worked out by hand from the definition in the
#           entry's source (no other implementation is run to produce it)
# The cases sit where an implementation could go wrong: the 32-bit limits and
# the values one past them, negative operands where truncation and flooring
# differ, a zero divisor, and the first quotient that no longer fits.
